annotations.coverageReview: Visible front and side survey images and corrected four-patch overlays inspected. Ember Phoenix upper face, beak, beak tip and side jaw are covered. The first lower-face pick incorrectly hit the throat and was rejected; the revised red patch lies on the hooked beak tip. Wings and body still require complete animation review. Original independent probe now detects deformation despite the earlier broad review passing.

review.name: Ember Phoenix
findings: All 13 source clips actually inspected in 12 enlarged face/body front/side slices. Beak curvature changes slightly on raised attack/cast; independent exposed-beak probe detects drift that the previous broad mask missed. Wings frequently occlude the side face, but front views retain coverage; claws, feathers and body remain connected. Recheck beak after conservative face repair; actual techniques pending. The corresponding battle face/body slices were also actually inspected; the same facial problem is present and there are no additional detached body surfaces in these raw clips. Equipped-technique review remains open.

Actual equipped-technique review exposed companion viewport clipping in strong strikes despite coherent face binding. A Phoenix-only fixed preview height now reserves its raised strike envelope. All nine corrected techniques and 24 fresh idle frames were actually inspected; final numeric raster boundary check has zero warnings.

companionTechniqueAudit.label: independent-legendary-006-techniques-v2
companionTechniqueAudit.finding: All 36 corrected front/side technique sheets were actually returned and visually inspected. Beak, crest, cheeks, wings, legs and tail remain coherent through each technique, including physical rises, compact casts, guard and return to idle. The entire character now stays in the preview at the strong strike peak.

V4 retains the lower beard extent but restores the conservative forward-depth and lateral limits; chest must remain behind the repair.
